steps.caption: The cache of an organisation's scan: SKILL_ATLAS_CACHE says where; start without one
The first scan: every repository is fetched
Again: only each repository's commit is asked for; the same output, sooner
--no-cache: every repository scanned again, the entries replaced
A broken cache never fails a scan: moved aside, a new one, a warning

steps.run: echo garbage > $SKILL_ATLAS_CACHE; ./skill-atlas scan github.com/Kotlin | head -2; ls $(dirname $SKILL_ATLAS_CACHE)

steps.caption: The web view uses the same cache: the same repositories and counts
